# SOP-P3-L2-01 Line startup - Ring Rolling line

Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P3, line P3-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L2-SB01, EQ-P3-L2-RR02, EQ-P3-L2-HT03  
Related documents: ECN-2026-044, MM-P3-L2-RR02, SOP-P3-L2-03

Purpose
1. Define the controlled procedure for start-up of the Ring Rolling production line at P3-L2, including safe checks, mechanical verifications, and initial run monitoring to confirm readiness for production.

Scope
2. Applies to all operators, maintenance personnel, and line supervisors conducting line start-up for the Ring Rolling line using EQ-P3-L2-SB01, EQ-P3-L2-RR02, and EQ-P3-L2-HT03.

Preconditions
3. Line area clear of non-essential personnel and debris.  
4. Lockout/tagout completed and released per site LOTO rules. Refer to MM-P3-L2-RR02 for maintenance isolation steps.  
5. Required spares, tooling, and records on the work station: shift log, maintenance checklist, and start-up inspection sheet.  
6. Communication devices operational; verify radio channel assignment with supervisor.

Personal protective equipment (PPE)
7. Mandatory PPE for start-up crew: safety glasses, hearing protection, steel-toe footwear, high-visibility vest, and heat-resistant gloves if handling warm components. Additional PPE as directed by site safety rules.

Key parameter confirmations (required before energizing)
8. Verify guarding and interlocks fully engaged on EQ-P3-L2-RR02 and EQ-P3-L2-HT03.  
9. Verify emergency stop circuits and light curtains function. Confirm reset procedure is understood by all crew.  
10. Verify the following equipment-specific items:
   - The blast wheel liner bolt torque for Ring Rolling shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L2-SB01) is 100 N·m.
   - The lubricant part number for Ring Rolling shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L2-SB01) is CFW-LUB-463.

Rationale and background
11. The blast wheel liner bolt torque value and lubricant part number are controlled to maintain shot blast performance and prevent unbalance or component loosening that could lead to equipment damage or production defects. Using the specified lubricant part number preserves material compatibility and viscosity required for bearings and seals. Refer to ECN-2026-044 for engineering change details affecting EQ-P3-L2-SB01.

Step-by-step start-up procedure
12. Ready checks
   12.1 Confirm preconditions in section 3 through 6 are satisfied.  
   12.2 Complete the pre-start checklist and attach it to the shift log.

13. Mechanical and electrical verification
   13.1 Visually inspect EQ-P3-L2-SB01, EQ-P3-L2-RR02, and EQ-P3-L2-HT03 for loose fasteners, foreign objects, and correct coupling alignment.  
   13.2 Confirm guard position switches read "closed" at the HMI before attempting any motor start.  
   13.3 Confirm the blast wheel liner bolts have been torqued to the documented value and that torque evidence is recorded on the inspection sheet.

14. Lubrication and consumables
   14.1 Confirm lubricant stock and that the lubricant used matches the documented part number; the lubricant part number for Ring Rolling shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L2-SB01) is CFW-LUB-463.  
   14.2 Check reservoir and feed indicators per the lubrication checklist. Record fill status and batch code if available.

15. Control system checks
   15.1 Power HMI and verify communication with PLCs for all three equipment items.  
   15.2 Confirm alarm history is clear of active faults. If faults are present, resolve per MM-P3-L2-RR02 before proceeding.

16. Dry run
   16.1 Perform an unloaded dry run using manual jogs to verify motion, end stops, and speed control responses. Observe for abnormal vibration, noise, or heat sources.  
   16.2 If abnormalities are detected, stop and notify maintenance per MM-P3-L2-RR02. Document the condition and corrective actions taken.

17. Initial loaded run
   17.1 With a single test ring piece, initiate normal production sequence at conservative operational parameters as determined by the line engineer.  
   17.2 Monitor product geometry, surface condition after EQ-P3-L2-SB01, and process stability through EQ-P3-L2-RR02 and EQ-P3-L2-HT03. Use sampling examples specified in SOP-P3-L2-03 for initial inspection points.  
   17.3 Record all observations on the start-up run log, including any adjustments and rationale.

Records to keep
18. Maintain the following documents with the start-up package:
   - Completed pre-start checklist.  
   - Torque verification record showing confirmation of The blast wheel liner bolt torque for Ring Rolling shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L2-SB01) is 100 N·m.  
   - Lubricant verification record showing The lubricant part number for Ring Rolling shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L2-SB01) is CFW-LUB-463.  
   - Initial run log and sample inspection results.  
   - Any maintenance actions and parts used, referenced to MM-P3-L2-RR02.

Examples and acceptable outcomes
19. Example 1: Dry run exhibits minor bearing noise that dissipates after a brief run and temperature stabilizes; document and continue to loaded run.  
20. Example 2: Persistent vibration or abnormal noise; stop immediately, tag equipment out of service, and issue a work order per MM-P3-L2-RR02.

Deviation handling
21. Any deviation from this standard operating procedure or failure to meet the documented confirmations requires immediate stop and notification of the line supervisor. Document deviations on the deviation form and reference ECN-2026-044 if related to changed components or configuration.

Sign-off
22. Start-up completion requires signatures from the following roles, recorded on the start-up sheet:
   - Operator performing checks: name, signature, date, time.  
   - Maintenance verifier: name, signature, date, time.  
   - Line supervisor clearance for production release: name, signature, date, time.

Attachments and references
23. Attach the completed pre-start checklist, torque verification, lubricant verification, and initial run log.  
24. Refer to ECN-2026-044 for engineering changes, MM-P3-L2-RR02 for maintenance and isolation procedures, and SOP-P3-L2-03 for inspection sampling during production start-up.
